I enjoy the concept, and i want to give this game a "like" but i want my opinion viewed and taken into consideration. so here are a few of my thoughts.

-Time to gamble is very rushed, i feel each round needs to be a min of 10 minutes
-There is zero point to go over quota, they need to make it so there is a point to reach for the stars and not being punished by a massively raised quota. I THINK AND FEEL that quota needs to be raised at a semi fixed rate, (previous quota x 2.5) AND let players keep the excess money!!!

 WELL WHAT TO DO WITH THE EXTRA???? use the extra as a reward to upgrade your house, beds, decore, ect, make house upgrades come with bonus's for the whole run. LIKE bed upgrade = 10% bonus luck.
THIS GIVES THE PLAYERS the feeling of purpose and reward rather than punish players with a massive qouta if they go above and beyond, OR make tickets used for items and MONEY used for permanant run upgrades like luck, more time, ect.

WELL WHAT DO WE DO AS DEVS SO PLAYERS DONT EXPLOIT MONEY!!! 
HERES WHAT ID DO!!! 

If a player is above quota BY 200% MAKE SECURITY START HUNTING THEM to kick them out!!! (like irl for winning to much lol) Players then would need to use the bats or other items to temperarily knock out security while trying to gamble more and more to upgrade your house or something

THE TICKET SYSTEM!!!!! if bonus 200% rewards the same tickets 5 AS 44000% IT FEELS USESLESS!!!!! why do extra??? MAKE TICKETS SCALE!!!! 100%-200% = 5 tickets, 400-500% =10 ticke

Suggestion to make a mode with unlimited time, the fun of slowly getting back from the zero is way more fun that trying to do X in 5 minutes all the time as it just gets too boring quickly after you find a strat that work 
 
Overall runs well and interesting ideas but overly restrictive, as a lot of these games, they tend to put a time limit which actually kills repleyability and a friendly conversations and hangout with your friends that the games like this supposed to bring rather than you joining friends to grind

Its fine, an hour or 2 of fun. There's fundamental problems with how rounds work and you kind of don't want to make more than you need to. No items are persistent so its not like other roguelite type games where you can sort of build a run up instead you go round by round with whatever items you can get in the shop which again.. its fine. 

I don't have any desire to play more currently, it feels like you kinda get the whole experience in that 2hr window so make up your mind on if its worth the price.

There needs to be a freeplay mode. Being pressured by a 5 minute timer is not fun. I have been looking forward to this since it was announced so this was quite disapointing as all the videos they posted showed people having fun and the time limit doesn't give you time to goof around or have fun.

Very fun in concept, but lacking in execution of gameplay overall...

Game is advertised first and foremost as a friendslop exploration of the flaws inherent to the gambler's fallacy, and to that extent it does succeed.

With that being said, there are imho a lot of problems with gameplay and mechanics.

First of all: The quota, and by extension money earned in the casino.
- It is simply too unforgiving for there being no upside to go more than at max 100% over quota.
- Even if you go for a max-cashout run and get hundreds of thousands in the casino, there is nothing to spend the money on. (Kaos-117's review addresses this issue in a way I fully agree with). There should be some incentive to win it big, one way to give that incentive could be a way to buy permanent upgrades. (For example buying furniture that gives boosts to a certain stat).

Secondly: The general experience in the Casino.
- The first sentence in the description states the game is meant as a "casino-crawler". Yet I don't get how this term is defined in the game itself. I thought it would be you had to do a buy-in to the casino, and higher floors means a higher buy-in. But in practice you just unlock a new floor either by needing to meet a higher quota, or by surviving a "run" for a set amount of days. The unlocking of a new floor isn't clearly announced pre entering the casino, so you can't even plan for having a higher floor unlocked until the day after you first unlock it.

It's alright. I'm giving this a negative review because it needs more to be reccomended over other friendslop games in the field.

It's charming at first and some of the humor gets a chuckle, but once you figure out how to rig a given casino game, there's very little to actually do, particularly later in the game when you realize that the floors aren't really any different from one another, they just give you bigger payouts. There needs to be more interactions beyond just, you win or lose at the end of the day. The trailer seems to imply the loan shark is a character you will interact with, and this is very much not the case. It would make the failure to clear a day more interesting if the loan shark did stuff like he did in the trailer (demanding the players mutilate themselves or eachother to continue), but there's none of that. You just restart. I also find that the body part removal system is pretty much a non-factor. Perhaps a "hardcore" mode where lost limbs can't be reattached would make the mechanic more impactful.

The biggest problem, really, is that for a co-operative game there isn't really all that much co-operating you can actually do, because like an actual casino the games are mostly solo. If there were ways for players to coordinate to cheat, that might make things more interesting. Game's fine but it's a pretty big drag even by the end of the first playthrough because you're just doing the same thing again and again, or dying because your dimwit friend won't

Meh. When I got the game, I told my friends "you guys should wait, it's pretty barebones right now but it's selling well so hopefully they will add more stuff.". It sold millions of copies, but now 5 months later they never added more stuff. There's better coop games out there for similar money. For 5 bucks on sale it's... fine? Decent 2 hours, so better value than a bad movie. But I had hoped the game that sells 2 million copies in a month had higher ambitions than that.
There's simply not much to this game. It's fun for a bit, but that almost completely relies on the interactions with friends. The gameplay itself does not have much substance.
it was fun for like an hour, but you very quickly run out of new stuff, and it gets repetitive
was cool at first, but at the end of the day it's just an EXTREMELY repetitive friendslop game that you'll maybe play 3-4 times before ultimately dropping it

Amusing for all of 1 hour. After that its just a game where a number goes up or down. Hitting your friend over the head with a baseball bat will net you like 15 extra minutes of fun, but this feels like something that could have just been a Roblox game.

good concept, but bad execution and the game gets old fast.
money becomes meaningless due to how repetitive the game is
the only way to win is the same few strategies over and over again, the ending feels generic and rushed.
still a good game to play with friends, it is fun, just not for long.

this game has an extremely finite amount of content and things to do in the game 
 
it's like lethal company, except instead of doing the stuff you do in lethal company, you play roulette for five minutes. You press E and wait for something to spin, to maybe win or maybe lose money. 
 
yes I understand this is what gambling is, but there is a very small amount of games, and its hard to get to different games without just doing repetitive nothing to get there. 
 
this could be a cool game if you had things to unlock beyond ugly and lazy looking outfits, I get the game is silly looking, but the cosmetics don't even usually look that silly either. 
 
like other people said, it would be more fun if it was less rushed, or if there were more meaningful permanent unlocks, or something you can do with excess money.  
 
they say they value your time and want to give you a digestible game, but the game is pretty easily digested in about 60 minutes. any further enjoyment you get is coming from friend interaction, and guess what, you can interact with friends for free.
it was good till i started gambling alone... and then... losing friends... and then my wife... then my money... then the kids... louise please come back i miss travis...

if there ever was a game for the friendslop category, it's this

it's not collaborative, and there are other free options to go play casino games with friends

the main gameplay loop is dull and boring. my group thought there were too many "confirm" steps in the gameplay loop, forcing a lot of wasted time between days
gets boring very fast, and resetting every run takes way too long. probably the worst friendslop i've played.

Games okayish but like not enough time to gamble and I was not expecting this game to be a quota based game and that makes it a very bad game I want to "Gamble with my friends' not 3 min of losing till next round. make a sand box or rework the quota stuff like maybe have more that just the day till you lose like other quota games or honestly take the whole quota concept out.

Had a lot of fun and beat the game twice with friends. 
But the use of Gen AI was never disclosed, and I would not have made the purchase had it been. 
 
I'll use an example for my thinking here: 
 
If a vegan orders a veggie burger, they expect a veggie burger. 
If someone orders a dish that is pork free for religious reasons, they expect it to be pork free. 
 
When there is no mention of Gen AI usage on the Steam Store page, 
I expect the game to have been made WITHOUT the planet-killing theft-machine. 
 
For people who mention the price being low and that I had fun playing it... 
You simply don't get it. 
 
I would not have spent money on this had I known they used Gen AI. 
Period.

When I first heard the term "Friendslop", I was appalled and confused. Really? That sounds like something a sad and lonely person would say. It was such a poignant term that I couldn't help but think of it in the back of my mind, while playing Lethal Company, playing R.E.P.O, playing PEAK, et cetera. Still, I kept it on the backburner of silent ridicule within my mind. I was, after all, enjoying the games I was playing, even if they marketed on the same general trend.

Gamble With Your Friends is the first game I have ever experienced where I couldn't help but relinquish my vocabulary to include this asinine word at the very tip of my tongue at every second of every minute I "played" this... product. It is nothing more, not to me, not to the developers, not to anybody. Utterly soulless, utterly mindless, and utterly substance-less. My only credit is that this game is exactly as advertised. You Gamble With Your Friends™! That's about it. 

You would think that a game centered about gambling would be right up my alley, given the fact that XCOM 2 is one of my favorite games ever. I call XCOM a "game" instead of a "product" because it requires a functioning cerebral cortex, largely opposed to Gamble With Your Friends, which was made to capitalize on the still remaining lobotomy victim population, and contains not but a few ways to slightly alter the house odds towards your favor. it's literally just gambling, but with zero progression across runs besides cosmetics.
While the game is super fun, it seems that they didn't disclose their usage of gen ai so I can't recommend

AI generated imagery used but not stated. Would not have gotten this game if I knew the devs cared so little about their product that they couldn't be bothered to even make a MS paint scribble as a placeholder.
There should at least be an incentive to replay the game when you beat it, there is no point at all to come back to it, friendslop strikes again.
though the game play is fun they have used generative AI for the banner and on several posters in the game so I will no longer be playing or encouraging anyone I know to play the game.

I would not have bought this game for me and my friends if I knew that Generative AI art was in this game. The fact that this game has a lot of normal charm and creativity despite the GenAI is a real shame because I will probably never open it again, even if it's fixed. I just feel lied to and betrayed. If your game contains AI art, I would like to know going in, or at least include it in the description for this game. I'm sorry to whoever worked on this game not knowing that AI was used, I hope that you can find better work elsewhere.
The game is fine, but holy crap take out the ready check to go back to the lobby...

Not enough content or diversity between runs. There are some minor roguelite elements with the item shop but those are typically only good for about 30 seconds of fun. Way too many loading screens and filler makes the process of moving between days and runs feel incredibly sluggish. You could play any number of free gambling web games with your friends and recreate a better experience than is provided by this game, save your money.

i wish the game was better but its just kind of not great
i think the concept just kind of falls flat when you realize that playing with more people actively makes the game worse because of how volatile it makes the shared money, and items being so powerful means that its only ever worth it to minmax one player and let everyone else do nothing so they dont waste money. for being a friendslop game it feels like it punishes you way too hard for having more friends.
the gambling also just does not feel very good. the only game that has any semblance of skill is street craps (because you can hit the second dice with a bat to rig the game to basically be unlosable most of the time. which feels kind of lame but losing constantly feels a lot worse!) and everything else tends to just make me feel like i need to lie down into a corner and cry because i lost the 50/50 like fifteen times in a row. its just pressing shiny buttons all the time so it can be fine but it gets old really fast.
the only enjoyment i got from playing this game was because it was with friends. there are better ways to spend $8 than being in a discord vc that stresses you out. theres also no maid outfit.
This game started my gambling addiction. Now I'm 2 quadrillionbillion dollars in debt and missing all my internal organs, my left arm, and half a testicle.

Tons of bugs. Hate the timer. No incentive to go above and beyond, especially with punishing RNG. We wont access to all games. Add sandbox mode and allow us to utilize excess profits for building out the base.

I will say the game is fun but could use some work. The game took a turn from what they originally had in mind it seem. At least compared to what was shown in the original trailer a ways back. The 5 minute rogue like concept is cool but it should be more of like a stand alone game mode. I thought the way the original trailer showed it were it was a sandbox like game was cool. Just build your money up and have fun no stressful timers and mess around with friends. I think if it had fun little mini games to earn money like jobs around the casino, scrubbing toilets, mopping floors, finding unclaimed cash inside the slot machines would be really cool way to get money back if you run yourself out of money. The game in the state its in I would say is worth the money while its on sale but it could have a little work done to make it so much better and have a better longevity for it and the little bit higher price point it will be at after the sale as well. I mean 4-5 hours isn't by all means bad for a $7 game but the sandbox would easily add a few more hours if not double into the life of the game. I am probably done with this game for now but if it ever comes out with a sandbox mode or something like that I will for sure be back to just mess around and gamble with my friends.

Gets boring quick, trying to progress and figure out how to win is hard, had to rely on glitches to have a chance of progressing and I was losing on the first level more than I ever won I played the game as supposed but never had fun or progressed only stress

I can see this being fun once or twice, but long-term it's a not worth it. Boredom started to kick in only after an hour or two of playing even with friends to elevate the experience. Earning extra cash means nothing, tickets for both cosmetics and necessary items seems like idiotic planning, and 5 minutes feels way too rushed. This game is quirky and appealing on the surface, but it's really not much underneath.

The earlier trailers for this game made it seem a lot more fun with a lot more features, and even playing it now it seems on the surface that it has much more depth than it actually does. its a lot less interactive than it lets on, many features from earlier trailers and dev comments didnt make the cut, and overall i was left disappointed after playing it. wish i could refund.

I usually don't have many issues with motion sickness in games (including VR), but I do with this game for some reason. So if you do easily get motion sick, I recommend you please skip this game (this may change in future).
But if you really want to play this, just close your eyes when waking up at the start of the day (you may have to press random buttons on the keyboard to stand up) and tell your friends not to hit you with a baseball bat (as this was especially nauseating)!
Also the option to turn off headbobbing doesn't make anything better because the headbobbing isn't the problem.

Motion sickness aside! It's both funny and frustrating when you just meet the quota and then your friends decide to continue gambling because they're "on a streak" (clearly not responsible gamblers!).
Though like others have already said, the gameplay loop does get very repetitive quickly and it lacks the dynamics of other co-op games to keep things relatively fresh. And because gambling games/machines are inherently random, this game is already at a disadvantage, as each time you gamble, nothing meaningful changes. Yes the games/machines rotate each in-game day and there are a few different levels of the casino (minimum spend changes), but ultimately you're pretty much doing the exact same thing every time (on later days it ends up coming down to just pressing spin on the machines heaps of times to try and win).

The game isn't that good, it's mid personally. It's a very repetitive game that gets boring incredibly quick. Most Co-op games like this usually doesn't make me want to stop playing this game after playing 20 minutes of it because all there is to do is gamble, hit your friend so they can't play the game or vice versa, or just make some random crap up. I wouldn't recommend this game if you want a Co-op game to play with your friends and play for awhile and enjoy it, that would be big walk. This game is the definition of "friend slop"

no gameplay in gambling. you just press a button and hope for the best 
fun in multiplayer cause of the goofy stuff but it gets boring after a while.

Initially entertaining but theres only so much gameplay before it gets extremely repetitive and you're either stuck playing the same two games or constantly having to restart because of bad RNG. Quotas, minimum and maximum bets mean absolutely nothing as there is no change in gameplay whether you have a billion dollars or a hundred and if you don't meet your quota nothing bad happens even though its in the description of the game "...hit your loan shark's daily quota... or face the consequences.". I would go as far as to say that the gambling mechanics in Fallout: New Vegas are far more interesting, fun and rewarding than the entirety of Gamble With Your Friends.

There is also very little progression besides cosmetic. The area outside the casino serves basically no purpose and it's disappointing that it's not used. It seems pointless to build such a large area where most of it is static and makes no difference to actual gameplay.

I wouldn't reccomend purchasing this game.

I dont understand the point. I cant invest my money to make my life easier, and winning big doesnt let you be safe, game just gives you higher and harder quota. So if you lose, you lose everything, if you win, you get another quota, if you win big you get even harder quota and thats it. And spending tickets on upgrades is just stressful, they aren't really here to help, they just might help you in short time. To me it would make more sense if the game rewarded you for being lucky and then you can decide to be safe for few rounds and try to advance further above next upcomming quotas or maybe add some permament upgrades to everyone in squad but that will require spending your funds, giving more risk to everyone.

This is a hard review to make, because the idea behind the game checks out "a gambling game where you actually gamble".. and well gambling feels bad, because gambling is not something you want to get addicted too and all.

The graphics are good, the interactivity with the machines are also nice!

But there's no point to really playing the game. The items don't really lead up to any crazy build where you're trying to fight against the game, and then in turn "break it". The rewards are minimal and you don't really benefit from playing with friends that much..

In award winning game Balatro, you're always thinking of ways you can put things together, either cards in your deck, the jokers with effects, or even the rewards for skipping blinds. It feels like the game is offering you a challenge, and it's just about how you take it, despite the rng elements.
And that's one of the aspects that make you WANT to gamble.

I wish I could give this a neutral, because that's what it deserves.

The game is fun for about half an hour, thanks entirely to the funny interactions you can have with your friends. There are baseball bats which can be used to smack your friends in the air. With a bit of skills, you can juggle them indefinitely, or even play tennis with their bodies.

You can also sell body parts for money, and there's a gun you can shoot at your friends to forcibly sell their parts for them. When someone loses their body, they become a head with arms and their only way to move around is to slowly roll, meaning others need to carry them to get most places. You can pass your friend's body around like hot potato, or if you have a bat, play baseball with their body.

All of this happens in the intro area, before the game actually begins. Once the novelty of all that wears off, you have to play the actual game, which sucks. You're put into a casino with roulette, duck racing, a wheel you can spin, blackjack, slots, and dice. Other than blackjack, none of these involve any skill whatsoever; you just press a button, and the game either gives you money or takes it away. There are items you can buy to stack the odds in your favor, making it possible to actually beat the game; but the entire game still amounts to pressing a button and crossing your fingers, which is not fun.

We gave it another half an hour, but at no point was the actual gambling fun, so we returned it. This game needs a major rewo

Nothing burger of a game, suitable for like 1-2 sessions.
The game is just playing various casino games in 5 minute intervals. There's not really any cooperation either

I wish I could choose a neutral review. 

The game is fine. It's not bad, but it's not great either. It quickly runs out its fun factor.

A game that is quite clearly the definition of Friendslop. Looks incredibly half-assed in its presentation. Shallow, next to nothing to do. There's more fun in gambling in other games where gambling isn't even the focus.

Boring. I was really excited when I saw their videos on Instagram, people having fun, playing freely, random fun shenanigans like popping out the trashcan etc (dont know if you can still do that but I haven't found a way to do it) and much more.. But this is just another friendslop. The 5 minute timer is highly restrictive, and all you do is go to different floors and just bet on stuff, then rinse and repeat. Wish it had more going on
Played it with friends, we got bored after an hour. A real casino might take all your money, but at least it gives you a dopamine hit.

I really want to like this game. The art style is silly, fun and incredibly charming and the first few sessions were quite fun, but I found that the game grew stale and repetitive very quickly.

In my opinion, this game is great for people who love gambling or people who want a decently casual virtual space to hang out and interact with friends. But if you're looking for a game to play with varied/dynamic gameplay or long-term (or per-run) progression, maybe wait for an update or two to release. I really think the game has some great potential, but it's not my thing in its current state.

cute silly game, however, misleading "camera comfort" settings
steam describes this as 'games that allow you to adjust or disable uncomfortable camera movement (such as screen shaking, camera bob, or motion blur), or doesn't feature these effects.'
even with view bob disabled, you're still sprung out of a box every time you spawn in, can be hit and flung in nauseating ways, and even if you are completely still - your camera still moves around slowly

additionally, the team's response to motion sick individuals is to 'kindly ask your friends to not throw you', instead of taking the steps to reduce dizzying movement.

Other people have said the same things as I am going to. There really feels like there's absolutely no strategy to this and no way to really have a good run other than absolute luck. Which I guess since the game is about gambling at least fits, I'll give them that. But it doesn't make a game that has any sort of longevity. You'll have basically seen all the game has to offer before its first hour passes. I am sure some items that actually effect the games more could easily fix this and a better balance on ticket costs for said items, but not sticking around in hopes it gets better.

IT HAS POTENTIAL BUT NEEDS WORK

As it stands, the gambling itself is fun. HOWEVER, there are bugs in the game that you cannot even report because the "report bugs" option just returns with a "404 not found" error. In terms of bugs, with blackjack, if you tie, you do not formally get your money back. It pops up saying you do but the overall won/lost amount on the side of the screen does not update, leading to a significant amount of money lost. 

I agree with the other comments that it needs to be balanced in terms of quota and that 5 minutes does feel quite rushed for game play. Overall, I think the game has a lot of potential, but these things definitely need to be addressed. As of right now, not recommending, but that may change.

Good game with plenty of fun mechanics, especially with your friends. However I dislike the Lethal Company/REPO quota portion of the game, especially since rounds are only 5 minutes. You spend probably 5 minutes grabbing items and looking at stuff, then 5 minutes actually playing. The rest is loading screens. Feels very anti-climactic especially after hitting really good runs. Would enjoy it more if either the timer was longer or there was an alt gamemode where we could hangout strictly at the casino. Would be a 5/5 for me otherwise :)
